first_error_behavior: Validate and Save preflight stop at the first ordered failure. Input and change handlers run independently. Final-copy/submission has its own ordered guards.

rules.condition: A keypress in year, sheet count, TIN core segments, ZIP code, or telephone is not a digit or an allowed control key.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.official_behavior: wholenumber permits digits plus Backspace, Tab, Enter, Escape and equivalent control keys.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Apply the same character filter, but also validate complete values after paste/programmatic assignment.

rules.condition: A branch-code keypress is not ASCII A-Z/a-z, 0-9, or an allowed control key.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.official_behavior: Branch input accepts ASCII alphanumeric characters and has maxlength 5.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Normalize to uppercase and validate the official branch-code shape as a complete value.

rules.condition: A runtime ATC tax-base keypress is not a digit, dot, or allowed control key.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.official_behavior: The later duplicate numbersonly declaration wins and permits any number of decimal points; blur round() converts malformed text to 0.00.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Accept one optional decimal point and reject malformed pasted/programmatic values instead of silently coercing them to zero.

rules.condition: Text exceeds the control maxlength.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.official_behavior: HTML maxlength bounds typed input: year 4, sheets 2, TIN cores 3 each, branch 5, name 50, each address line 150, ZIP 12, telephone 20, email 20.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Enforce the same storage limits with explicit validation errors, including paste and import paths.

rules.condition: Taxpayer name or address loses focus.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.official_behavior: capital uppercases and trims the value on blur.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Normalize deterministically at the model boundary as well as in the editor.

rules.condition: A tax base loses focus.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.official_behavior: round() truncates integer input to 12 digits, rounds half-up to two decimals, comma-groups, and coerces NaN or excess precision to 0.00.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Use decimal arithmetic, reject excess precision/length explicitly, and never silently replace malformed input with zero.

rules.condition: Taxable year changes.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.official_behavior: Existing selected ATC rates and withheld amounts are recomputed; for year <=2018 WI/WC650=25%, WI/WC651=32%, and WI/WC663 or WI/WC710=20%. For later years the package catalog is used, but it retains confirmed stale/wrong rates including Government WC651=32 and WC710=20, and WI/WC661=10, where the January 2019 form prints 15.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Represent rates as effective-dated, revision-scoped catalog data; for January 2019 use the official PDF values and recompute dependent amounts transactionally.

rules.condition: Category changes after at least one ATC row exists and the user confirms.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: By changing Category your selected ATC will be remove.
rules.official_behavior: A confirmation is shown; confirmation clears Items 19-30, all selected ATCs, and both ATC tables. Cancellation reverses the category radio choice.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Use grammatical warning text and clear only after an explicit confirmation while preserving a recoverable undo state.

rules.condition: Amended Return No is selected.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.official_behavior: Item 22 is disabled, reset to 0.00, and downstream totals are recomputed.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Apply the same dependency and preserve the prior value only in reversible editor state, not submitted data.

rules.condition: Any Taxes Withheld changes from Yes to No after ATCs exist and the user confirms.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: You are about to change the value . Doing this will clear all \n computation fields Do you wish to proceed?
rules.official_behavior: Confirmation clears Items 19-30 and all ATC rows; cancellation restores Yes.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Use corrected message text and a reversible confirmation.

rules.condition: Item 30 changes sign.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.official_behavior: Negative Item 30 enables the three disposition choices; zero or positive clears and disables all three.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Apply the same state rule.

rules.condition: One Item 30 over-remittance disposition is checked.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.official_behavior: Checking one choice clears the other two.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Model as a single enum rather than three independent booleans while preserving XML compatibility.

rules.condition: Item 11 category filters the package ATC catalog.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.official_behavior: Private renders 111 ordered slots and Government renders 96; four malformed categoryless catalog records are loaded but unreachable.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Keep the malformed records in provenance data, exclude them from selectable choices, and validate the catalog during ingestion.

rules.condition: Item 1 is blank.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid year on Item 1.
rules.official_behavior: Stops, focuses Item 1, and returns false.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Require a four-digit year.

rules.condition: Item 1 is greater than the current calendar year.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Invalid entry on Item 1. Entry should not be a future Date.
rules.official_behavior: Resets Item 1 to the current year, focuses it, and stops.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Reject without silently mutating the user value.

rules.condition: Item 1 is less than 2018.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Invalid entry on Item 1. Entry should not be a previous year from 2018.
rules.official_behavior: Clears Item 1, focuses it, and stops.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Enforce the revision applicability boundary explicitly.

rules.condition: Q1 of the current year is selected before April.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Unable to select first Quarter due to the current date. Payment should be made after the Quarter
rules.official_behavior: Clears Q1 and stops; a prior-year Q1 is accepted.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Use a filing-period calendar service and preserve selection on error.

rules.condition: Q2 of the current year is selected before July.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Unable to select second Quarter due to the current date. Payment should be made after the Quarter
rules.official_behavior: Clears Q2 and stops; a prior-year Q2 is accepted.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Use a filing-period calendar service and preserve selection on error.

rules.condition: Q3 of the current year is selected before October.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Unable to select third Quarter due to the current date. Payment should be made after the Quarter
rules.official_behavior: Clears Q3 and stops; a prior-year Q3 is accepted.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Use a filing-period calendar service and preserve selection on error.

rules.condition: Q4 of the current year is selected.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Unable to select fourth Quarter due to the current date. Payment should be made after the Quarter
rules.official_behavior: Always clears current-year Q4 and stops; only prior-year Q4 is accepted.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Make the end-of-quarter eligibility rule explicit and timezone-stable.

rules.condition: No quarter radio is selected.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please select Quarter on Item 2
rules.official_behavior: Stops at Item 2.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Require exactly one quarter.

rules.condition: Neither Item 4 radio is selected.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please select an option for Item 4.
rules.official_behavior: Stops at Item 4.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Require exactly one choice.

rules.condition: Neither Item 11 category radio is selected.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please select an option for Item 11.
rules.official_behavior: Stops at Item 11.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Require exactly one category.

rules.condition: Any Item 6 TIN core segment or branch code is blank.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid TIN number on Item 6.
rules.official_behavior: Only nonblankness is tested; partial core segments, a one-character branch, and no checksum validation can pass.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Require exactly 3-3-3 core digits, a valid branch representation, and the shared TIN checksum where applicable.

rules.condition: Item 7 select has selectedIndex 0.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid RDO Code on Item 7.
rules.official_behavior: Stops when the placeholder RDO is selected.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Require a catalog-backed RDO code.

rules.condition: Item 8 name is blank.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid Taxpayer Name on Item 8.
rules.official_behavior: Stops on blank name.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Require a nonblank trimmed withholding-agent name.

rules.condition: Item 10 telephone is blank.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid Telephone Number on Item 10.
rules.official_behavior: Requires a telephone number but validates no length or format beyond keypress filtering.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Confirm the legal/guide requirement; if required, validate a complete contact number rather than nonblankness.

rules.condition: Item 9 address is blank.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please enter Taxpayer's Registered Address on Item 9.
rules.official_behavior: Checks only the first address control, although save concatenates two controls.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Validate the combined registered address and preserve line boundaries explicitly.

rules.condition: Item 9A ZIP is blank.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please enter Taxpayer's Zip Code on Item 9A.
rules.official_behavior: Requires a digit-only ZIP but performs no complete-value validation.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Confirm requiredness and validate an allowed Philippine postal-code representation.

rules.condition: Item 12 email is blank.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please enter valid Email Address on Item 12.
rules.official_behavior: Any nonblank string up to 20 characters passes; no email syntax check is called.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Validate a syntactically valid email and allow the official published maximum if it exceeds this UI limit.

rules.condition: Item 4 is Yes and the first ATC row is blank.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please fill up Part II Computation of Tax if item 4 is set to Yes.
rules.official_behavior: Shows the ATC modal and returns without an explicit false value.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Require at least one selected ATC and return a typed validation failure.

rules.condition: For any selected ATC row, Tax Base is blank or compares equal to 0.00.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid value for tax base for {ATC_CODE}.
rules.official_behavior: Scans rows in display order and stops at the first blank/zero tax base.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Require a positive decimal tax base for each selected ATC and identify the row/code.

rules.condition: Item 30 is negative and no over-remittance disposition is selected.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please select an Overpayment option in Part II Item 30.
rules.official_behavior: Stops when no disposition is selected.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Require exactly one disposition for a negative amount.

rules.condition: All earlier Validate checks pass.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Validation successful. Click on Edit if you wish to modify your entries.
rules.official_behavior: Stores Part II table size, disables editable controls, enables Edit/upload/final-copy paths, and shows success.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Use an explicit validated state invalidated by any model change.

rules.condition: Any Item 6 TIN core segment or branch code is blank.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid TIN number on Item 6.
rules.official_behavior: Save preflight checks only nonblankness and permits partial/invalid TIN values.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Use the same complete TIN validation for Save and Validate, or explicitly allow drafts without claiming validity.

rules.condition: Item 7 value is 000.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid RDO Code on Item 7.
rules.official_behavior: Save stops on the RDO placeholder.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Require a catalog-backed RDO for non-draft saves.

rules.condition: Item 8 name is blank.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid Withholding Agent's Name on Item 8.
rules.official_behavior: Save stops with wording different from Validate.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Use one consistent field label and message.

rules.condition: TIN, RDO, and name pass Save preflight even if every other Validate rule fails.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.official_behavior: Draft Save does not invoke validateForm and may persist otherwise invalid/incomplete return data.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Support explicit drafts, clearly label them unvalidated, and require full validation for final-copy/submission.

rules.condition: The two address controls are serialized and reopened.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.official_behavior: Both controls are concatenated into one escaped XML value without a delimiter; reopen splits the escaped byte-like string at position 127, which can move the line boundary or split a percent escape.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Serialize address lines losslessly as separate modeled values while retaining the official combined XML projection.

rules.condition: A saved return is reopened.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.official_behavior: The saved txtEmail is read, then overwritten with globalEmail from the active profile.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Preserve the return email on reopen and surface any profile mismatch as an explicit user choice.

rules.condition: A non-amended filename family already contains an amended V-version.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: If your intention is to make an amended return, kindly tick Amended Return to 'Yes' before hitting 'Save' or 'Final Copy' or 'Submit'.
rules.official_behavior: Save is refused to avoid overwriting/creating a non-amended return after amended versions exist.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Preserve explicit versioning and prevent ambiguous overwrite.

rules.condition: Submit / Final Copy is invoked after successful Validate and no prior final-state resend branch applies.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please ensure that you have INTERNET access and a VALID email address is indicated in your tax return.\n\nAre you sure you want to submit?
rules.official_behavior: The button is a submission-first workflow; it does not offer a separate ordinary local final-copy action before checking Internet.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Separate local final-copy generation from optional online submission.

rules.condition: The user confirms final-copy/submission but checkNetConnection reports no Internet.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: The system detected that you have no internet connection.\nPlease contact your internet service provider.
rules.official_behavior: Sets txtFinalFlag=3, invokes saveEncryptedProfile/saveXML(true), and creates an encrypted IAF_RDO_Copy artifact despite reporting no connection.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Allow deterministic offline final copy directly and document state transitions without relying on a network probe.

rules.condition: A read-only final copy with txtFinalFlag other than 2 is saved again.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: You will no longer be allowed to modify since this is already the final copy.\nDo you want to save this in USB flash drive or CD-RW instead?
rules.official_behavior: Confirmation generates and encrypts an IAF_RDO_Copy artifact and opens export selection; cancellation stops.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Provide an explicit export-copy action with the same immutability semantics.

rules.condition: A final non-amended return already exists and the current attempt is not a special resend state.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: If your intention is to make an amended return, kindly tick Amended Return to 'Yes' before hitting 'Save' or 'Final Copy' or 'Submit'.
rules.official_behavior: Final-copy/submission is refused.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Preserve immutable versioning and require an explicit amended return.

rules.condition: Online enrollment/credential confirmation proceeds.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.official_behavior: May set txtEnroll=Y, copies the password into serialized ebirOnlineSecret, then generates an encrypted final copy before transport.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Never serialize plaintext credentials into return XML; use platform credential storage.
unresolved_questions: The encrypted-output credential exposure has not been decrypted and inspected for this form package.

rules.condition: RenameAndSendFile returns 0.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Submit Successful. Subject to validation by BIR. \n\n A notification will be sent to your email ({EMAIL}). Please print or save the email as an evidence of efiled return.
rules.official_behavior: Sets txtFinalFlag=1, updates the save file, shows success, and offers payment options.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Only mark submitted after an authenticated server acknowledgement; store immutable receipt evidence.
unresolved_questions: Online submission was intentionally not performed.

rules.condition: Transport returns nonzero or throws.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message:
Your Tax Return was not submitted online due to any of the 
 following reasons that may interrupt the submission process: 
 - No internet connection 
 - Slow internet connection 
 - Overly restrictive firewall
rules.official_behavior: Sets txtFinalFlag=2 and updates the save file for resend.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Record the actual transport error safely, retain a retryable state, and avoid claiming one of several guessed causes.
unresolved_questions: Online submission was intentionally not performed.
